title: Apparent Age
paragraphs: Father caught Sakura-chan and then gently set her down.
“Um, Sakura-chan?”
“Yup! It’s me, Sakura!”
“I see, I see.”
“Naofumi, pet me~”
“Alright, alright.”
Father gently stroked Sakura-chan’s head.
“Motoyasu-kun, uh… Sakura-chan’s appearance doesn’t match what you described…”
“That’s strange, isn’t it?”
Last time, Sakura-chan was about the same height as Éclair and the other older girls. Her apparent age looked similar too. But now, she didn’t look much different from Yuki-chan and the others.
“More importantly, all three of them are completely naked! We need to get them dressed!”
“Ordinary clothes would just tear apart when they transform, I say.”
“Achoo!”
With a soft poof, Sakura-chan’s transformation reverted. Ren, Itsuki, and Éclair all stared in shock, mouths agape, pointing at her.
“I’ve heard about this before, but seeing it in person makes it real…”
“Ah~ So fluffy~”
Kou ran straight toward Itsuki.
“You must be Kou-san. It’s nice to meet you properly.”
“Yup! Kou wants to try eating Kawasumi’s fluffy stuff!”
“…Fluffy stuff? You mean my hair!? Now that you mention it, you have been nibbling on it sometimes… Were you targeting it!?”
“Looks like you’ve been adopted, Itsuki.”
“I am not happy about this! What is even happening!?”
Kou playfully clung to Itsuki. Meanwhile, Itsuki… Well, he looked like he wasn’t too thrilled about it. No way he actually dislikes Filolials, right? Must be my imagination.
Yuki-chan and Ren silently stared at each other.
“Well? What do you think?”
“Hmm… Interesting.”
Though he said that, Ren quickly averted his gaze from the naked Yuki-chan.
“A high-combat, human-transforming monster, huh… Motoyasu is their owner, but maybe I should consider raising one myself for the future?”
“If you raise too many, the food costs will be insane, though.”
“Yeah, they were eating a ton tonight too.”
“At this rate, if more show up, I’ll be the one struggling the most.”
Father responded while playing around with Sakura-chan.
“At the very least, we should wait until we’re a bit stronger first. Well, having more allies is never a bad thing.”
“Still, what do you think about using Filolials to fill out your party, aside from Eclair-san?”
“That’s a fair point.”
“I think we should limit it to maybe one per Ren and Itsuki, at most.”
“I’ll consider it.”
“Having more allies is wonderful. But if there are too many to maintain, that would be counterproductive… As expected of the Heroes, thinking ahead.”
“Yuki-chan’s speech patterns sound kind of refined all of a sudden.”
“A high-class tone, huh…”
“Fluffy~”
“Whoa! These kids can even talk in their Filolial forms!?”
Itsuki, who was being playfully nibbled on, pushed Kou away as he spoke.
“Yeah… they’re definitely talking. So, what should we do for now?”
“Sakura wants to sleep with Naofumi~… So sleepy…”
“Ah, yeah, yeah. But if you turn into your Filolial form in the inn, you might break the floor. We also need to get clothes… Should we camp outside tonight?”
“No, no! Even if the bed is hard, I’d much rather sleep in the inn. Why would we go out of our way to camp!?”
Itsuki objected strongly.
“For now, let’s get some clothes ready for Yuki-chan and the others. Here, I need each of you to spin these spools of thread.”
I showed them the spinning wheels I had loaded onto the carriage earlier. I had bought them with money to spare, so we could take our time preparing.
“We just spin these?”
“Yuki will go first.”
“Fluffyyy~”

Oh? It seems Kou was more interested in playing with Itsuki than helping. Meanwhile, Yuki-chan slowly started turning the spinning wheel. I still remember how, last time, Kou had spun it wildly with loud whirring noises.
“Naofumi~… Sakura…”
“Yeah, yeah? I get it, but no turning into a Filolial in the inn, okay?”
“Okaaay.”
“Alright, I’m giving you a robe to wear, so you absolutely can’t tear it. If you rip it, you’re sleeping outside.”
“Aww… Okayyy.”
What a heartwarming sight. Éclair prepared three robes, and along with Father, started dressing Yuki-chan and the others.
“Kou, stop clinging to Itsuki and get your clothes ready too.”
“Okaaay!”
Kou lined up behind Yuki-chan, hopping excitedly. She looked like she was having a great time. I couldn’t help but bounce along with her.
“Why is Motoyasu hopping around with Kou…?”
“It’s like there’s two of him now.”
“Please spare me… Ugh…”
Itsuki was by the river, washing his hair again.
“Ugh, my hair’s all messed up…”
“Well, if you think of it as her being affectionate, isn’t it kind of cute?”
“I guess…”
“Heh, things are getting lively around here. This should make it easier to move around in Siltvelt.”
“Yeah… It might also mean fewer suspicious looks directed at us. For now, let’s just act like we’re accompanying them.”
“This world really does have a lot of discrimination, huh?”
“Do you think it’s impossible to create a world without discrimination…?”
Itsuki asked Father, Ren, and Éclair with a troubled expression.

“Discrimination and distinction are different, and they’re also different from equality, but I don’t think human perception will ever change. Changing the world around you takes an incredible amount of effort, and even if we try to correct it, things will eventually revert back somewhere down the line.”
“Even in Japan, where we came from, discrimination existed, so isn’t it impossible to eliminate it completely?”
Itsuki looked stunned by my response.
“Yeah, people don’t change so easily. Even in our own world, discrimination existed, despite being from Japan. Just because this is another world doesn’t mean we can magically erase it.”
“…I thought that, as heroes, we might be able to do something about it.”

“That might just be ruling by force. If you want to impose your own sense of justice on others, you’d have to literally conquer the world and hammer that idea into people over multiple generations. Even then, there’s no guarantee it would work.”
“Naofumi-san, that makes it sound like something a villain would do.”

“From some perspectives, it is villainous. But that’s often what it means to eliminate discrimination. In manga or anime, it might seem like everything suddenly becomes equal, but that’s just a dream. Even if the opposing side appears to accept it, in the end, it’s just submission through power.”

“Ah, so you’re saying that forcing people to accept something through strength might seem good from our point of view… Wait, isn’t this exactly what Itsuki was doing that Motoyasu was talking about earlier?”
“I see… Imposing my sense of justice to control others… That’s the dark side of what I was trying to do. I should reflect on that.”
Oh? It seems Itsuki actually understood.
That same Itsuki? Really?
“That aside, I’m getting pretty sleepy. Can we head back to the inn now?”
Itsuki and Ren both let out yawns.
“Spinning, spinning~!”
As soon as Yuki-chan finished winding the thread, Kou eagerly started spinning the spool. At this point, seeing Sakura reminded me of what happened two times ago.
“This is going to take a while, so why don’t Ren and Itsuki go ahead and rest at the inn?”
“…Yeah, you’re right. Then, we’ll take you up on that offer and head to bed first.”
“Understood. I’ll escort you to the inn.”
“Oh, what about you, Naofumi? And Motoyasu?”
“I’ll stay until Sakura is done getting ready.”
“Hmm?”

As always, Father was great at taking care of Sakura. Last time, I felt like there was a bit of distance between them, but now she seems much more affectionate, which makes her even cuter in my opinion. That said, back then, she had a quiet yet strong-willed demeanor… Maybe. Now, she’s just a sweet girl who openly clings to Father.
“I’ll wait until Father and the others are done.”
Last time, I went ahead and slept first, so this time, I’ll keep watch. In the end, I’ll just be waiting around tomorrow for the clothes to be made anyway, so this is fine.
“Alright. Just don’t stay out too late—make sure to get some rest.”
“I know, I know.”
“Especially you, Naofumi. You’re in charge of cooking, so you should rest early.”
“Honestly, I’d like to just eat breakfast somewhere else tomorrow.”
“…I really don’t want to throw up again.”
“Yeah.”
“Maybe we could just buy some bento somewhere.”

Despite saying that, Ren and Itsuki just gave noncommittal replies. At this rate, it’s basically a guarantee that Father will end up making bento again tomorrow. Ren and Itsuki have already become addicted to his cooking. Soon enough, they won’t be able to survive without it. As I grinned at the thought, Ren and Itsuki shuddered and quickly left for the inn with Éclair.
“Motoyasu-kun, why are you grinning like that? It doesn’t suit you.”
“I was just laughing at how Ren and Itsuki are falling under Father’s spell.”
“I’m not brainwashing anyone!!”
And so, we successfully secured materials for Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan’s clothes.
